The information you gave / were not / sufficient for processing the claim.

questions.q: The main idea of the passage is that:
o: Non-wage factors strongly influence women's workforce participation
Higher wages alone attract women workers
questions.x: Answer: 'Non-wage factors strongly influence women's workforce participation'. The passage emphasises transport, childcare and attitudes alongside wages. The other options either add ideas not found in the passage or contradict it.
questions.p: Women's participation in the paid workforce rises and falls for reasons that are not purely economic. Safe transport, childcare, flexible hours and social attitudes often matter as much as wages. When a factory offers a creche and a bus service, it may find that more women apply than when it merely raises pay. Policies that ignore these conditions may wonder why higher wages fail to attract workers, while the real barriers remain untouched.

questions.q: Which facility is mentioned as possibly attracting more women applicants?
o: A creche and a bus service
questions.x: Answer: 'A creche and a bus service'. The example cites a creche and a bus service. The other options either add ideas not found in the passage or contradict it.
questions.p: Women's participation in the paid workforce rises and falls for reasons that are not purely economic. questions.q:
Consider the following:

o: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true

questions.x: Correct answer: Government expenditure exceeds government receipts. Various measures — revenue, fiscal, primary — are used.

Comprehensive financial services for small businesses and low-income households

questions.q: The Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana provides loans to non-corporate small businesses under categories Shishu, Kishore, Tarun and (since 2024) Tarun Plus. The upper limit under Tarun Plus is:
questions.x: Shishu up to ₹50,000; Kishore up to ₹5 lakh; Tarun up to ₹10 lakh; Tarun Plus up to ₹20 lakh.

questions.q: In an economy, GDP at market prices is ₹3,46,000 crore, net factor income from abroad is ₹-2,500 crore and depreciation is ₹11,000 crore. NNP at market prices is:
Purchases during a month: 1st — 100 units @ ₹19; 10th — 200 units @ ₹20; 20th — 300 units @ ₹24. 200 units were issued on the 25th. Value of closing stock under FIFO is:
questions.x: Under FIFO the earliest units are issued first, so the 400 units left come from the latest purchases: 300 × ₹24 + 100 × ₹20 = ₹9,200.

questions.q: Under the modern approach, an increase in a liability is recorded by a:
questions.x: Liabilities, capital and revenues normally have credit balances.

questions.q: Recording only those transactions that can be expressed in monetary terms follows the:
questions.x: Correct answer: Money measurement concept. Non-monetary events, such as employee morale, are not recorded.

questions.q: The Economic Order Quantity (EOQ) formula is:
questions.x: A = annual demand, O = ordering cost per order, C = carrying cost per unit per year.

questions.q: Net sales are ₹5,40,000 and the cost of goods sold is ₹4,32,000. The gross profit ratio is:
questions.x:
Gross profit = 5,40,000 − 4,32,000 = ₹1,08,000.
GP ratio = GP / Net sales × 100 = 20%. (Dividing by COGS gives mark-up, not GP ratio.)

questions.q: The Receipts and Payments Account of a not-for-profit organisation is a summary of:
o: Income and expenditure on accrual basis
questions.x: It is like a cash book; it includes capital and revenue items of all periods.

questions.q: On an intra-State supply, GST is levied as:
questions.x: Correct answer: CGST plus SGST/UTGST. Inter-State supplies attract IGST.

questions.q: The current ratio of a company is 2 : 1 and its working capital is ₹50,000. Its current assets amount to:
questions.x:
Let current liabilities = x. Then current assets = 2x and working capital = 2x − x = 1x.
1x = 50,000 → x = ₹50,000.
Current assets = 2 × 50,000 = ₹1,00,000.

questions.q: Fixed costs are ₹62,500, selling price is ₹300 per unit and variable cost is ₹275 per unit. The break-even point in units is:
questions.x:
Contribution per unit = 300 − 275 = ₹25.
BEP (units) = Fixed cost / Contribution per unit = 62,500 / 25 = 2,500 units.

questions.q: P and Q share profits in the ratio 4 : 1. They admit R for a 1/5 share, which R acquires from P and Q in their existing ratio. The new profit-sharing ratio of P, Q and R is:

questions.q: The accounting equation 'Assets = Liabilities + Capital' is based on the:
questions.x: Correct answer: Dual aspect concept. Every transaction has two equal and opposite effects.

Match the Labour Code with a law it subsumed:
Labour Code:
A. Code on Wages
B. Industrial Relations Code
C. Code on Social Security
D. OSH Code
Subsumed law:
1. Mines Act, 1952
2. Employees' Compensation Act, 1923
3. Payment of Bonus Act, 1965
4. Trade Unions Act, 1926
Select the correct answer using the code given below:
questions.x:
Correct matching — A (Code on Wages) → 3 (Payment of Bonus Act, 1965); B (Industrial Relations Code) → 4 (Trade Unions Act, 1926); C (Code on Social Security) → 2 (Employees' Compensation Act, 1923); D (OSH Code) → 1 (Mines Act, 1952).
Bonus → Code on Wages; Trade Unions → IR Code; Employees' Compensation → Code on Social Security; Mines → OSH Code.

questions.q: Under the OSH Code, which of the following establishments is covered irrespective of the number of workers employed?
questions.x: Mines and docks are covered irrespective of the number of workers because of inherent risks.

questions.q: 'Distributive bargaining' in labour negotiations refers to:
o: Bargaining over a fixed pie where one side's gain is the other's loss
questions.x: Distributive bargaining is win–lose (typically wages), while integrative bargaining seeks win–win outcomes.

questions.q: India's status in the ILO Governing Body has been notable because India:
o: Is the only country without voting rights
Has held a non-elective seat as one of the ten states of chief industrial importance
questions.x: India, a founding member (1919), has been among the ten countries of chief industrial importance holding non-elective government seats.

questions.q: The 'Samadhan' portal of the Ministry of Labour and Employment is used for:
o: Online filing and monitoring of industrial disputes and grievances
questions.x: SAMADHAN (Software Application for Monitoring and Disposal, Handling of Industrial Disputes) helps workers and employers file disputes online.

questions.q: The OSH Code limits the daily working hours of a worker to not more than:
questions.x: Section 25: no worker shall be required or allowed to work for more than eight hours in a day (weekly limits are notified).

questions.q: Under the Code on Wages, the minimum bonus payable in an accounting year is:
o: 8.33% of wages or ₹1,000, whichever is higher
8.33% of wages or ₹100, whichever is higher
questions.x: Section 26: minimum bonus is 8.33% of wages earned or ₹100, whichever is higher, whether or not the employer has allocable surplus.

questions.q: In an establishment employing 60 workers, a trade union seeks registration. Under the IR Code, the minimum number of members it needs is:
questions.x: 10% of 60 = 6 workers, which is less than 100, but the Code requires at least seven members — so 7.

questions.q: Which Act regulated the employment of dock workers before the OSH Code?
o: Dock Workers (Safety, Health and Welfare) Act, 1986
questions.x: The Dock Workers (Safety, Health and Welfare) Act, 1986 is among the 13 laws merged into the OSH Code.

questions.q: A worker employed under fixed-term employment under the Labour Codes becomes eligible for gratuity after completing:
questions.x: The Codes make fixed-term employees eligible for gratuity on a pro-rata basis after one year of continuous service (instead of five).

questions.q: The Mines Act was passed by the legislature in the year:
questions.x: The Mines Act was enacted in 1952.

questions.q: The Trade Disputes Act, 1929 is notable because it:
o: Provided for courts of inquiry and boards of conciliation and restricted strikes in public utilities
questions.x: Correct answer: Provided for courts of inquiry and boards of conciliation and restricted strikes in public utilities. The 1929 Act was a forerunner of the Industrial Disputes Act, 1947.

questions.q: A daily-rated casual worker must be paid under the Code on Wages:
o: At the end of the month
At the end of the shift
At the end of the week

questions.q: The Cine-Workers Welfare Fund Act and the Cine-Workers and Cinema Theatre Workers (Regulation of Employment) Act were both enacted in:
questions.x: Both 1981 laws dealt with cine workers; the former went into the Code on Social Security and the latter into the OSH Code.

questions.q: Which Article of the Constitution prohibits employment of children below 14 years in factories, mines or other hazardous employment?
questions.x: Article 24 is a Fundamental Right against exploitation.

questions.q: 'Attrition' in HR terminology means:
o: Reduction of workforce through resignation, retirement or death
questions.x: Attrition is the gradual reduction in employees through natural causes.

questions.q: An eligible employee earns ₹14,500 per month. The notified minimum wage for the employment is ₹9,500 per month. If the establishment declares bonus at 8.33%, the annual bonus payable is (statutory computation):
questions.x:
For computing bonus, salary is capped at ₹7,000 or the minimum wage, whichever is higher: max(7,000, 9,500) = ₹9,500.
Salary for computation = min(14,500, 9,500) = ₹9,500.
Annual bonus = 9,500 × 12 × 8.33% = ₹9,496. Bonus must lie between 8.33% and 20%.

questions.q: Under EPS 1995, children's pension is payable to how many children at a time and up to what age?
o: Two children, till 25 years of age
questions.x: Children's pension (25% of widow pension each) is paid to two children at a time until 25; a disabled child gets it for life.

questions.q: Since 1 July 2019, ESI contribution rates are:
questions.x: Correct answer: Employer 3.25% and employee 0.75%. The total rate was cut from 6.5% to 4% in 2019 to encourage coverage.

questions.q: From 1 October 2022, which persons are NOT eligible to join Atal Pension Yojana?
questions.x: Income-tax payers were made ineligible to target the scheme at the unorganised sector.

questions.q: 'Means testing' in social security refers to:
o: Assessing a claimant's income or assets to determine eligibility
questions.x: Means-tested benefits target those below a threshold, e.g., BPL-linked pensions.

questions.q: Under the National Family Benefit Scheme (NFBS), a BPL household gets a lump sum on the death of the primary breadwinner aged 18–59. The amount is:
questions.x: NFBS provides ₹20,000 as one-time assistance.

questions.q: The Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act guarantees each rural household at least how many days of wage employment a year?
questions.x: MGNREGA (2005) guarantees 100 days of unskilled manual work; drought-hit areas may get 150 days.

questions.q: An employee retires after 25 years of continuous service. Last drawn monthly wages (basic + DA) are ₹53,000. Gratuity payable under the statutory formula (non-seasonal establishment) is:
questions.x:
Gratuity = 15/26 × last drawn wages × completed years of service.
= 15/26 × 53,000 × 25 = ₹7,64,423 (well within the ₹20 lakh ceiling).
The divisor 26 reflects working days in a month.

questions.q: The EPF & MP Act, 1952 generally applies to establishments in scheduled industries or notified classes employing at least:
questions.x: Section 1(3): 20 or more persons; establishments with fewer may opt for voluntary coverage under Section 1(4).

questions.q: The due date for an employer to remit EPF contributions for a month is:
o: 30 days after the end of the quarter
Last day of the same month
questions.x: Contributions and the Electronic Challan-cum-Return (ECR) are due by the 15th of the following month.

questions.q: Before July 2019, the combined ESI contribution rate was:
questions.x: Correct answer: 6.5% (4.75% employer + 1.75% employee). It was reduced to 4% from 1 July 2019.

questions.q: The Employees' Provident Funds Act came into force in:
questions.x: It was preceded by an Ordinance of 15 November 1951 and enacted as the EPF Act on 4 March 1952.

questions.q: Stainless steel is an alloy of iron with:
questions.x: Correct answer: Chromium and nickel (and carbon). Chromium forms a protective oxide layer.

questions.q: In computing, 'HTML' stands for:
o: American Standard Code for Information Interchange
questions.x: HTML = HyperText Markup Language.

questions.q: 'Booting' a computer means:
o: Loading the operating system into memory when the computer starts
questions.x: Correct answer: Loading the operating system into memory when the computer starts. Cold boot starts from power off; warm boot restarts.

questions.q: India's national agency for responding to cyber security incidents is:
questions.x: Correct answer: CERT-In. It functions under the Ministry of Electronics and IT.

questions.q: The normal human body temperature is about:
Beriberi is caused by the deficiency of:

questions.q: Vaccination against smallpox is credited to:
questions.x: Vaccination against smallpox: Edward Jenner.

questions.q: A odometer is used to measure:
questions.x: Odometer: Distance travelled by a vehicle.

questions.q: Which abbreviation stands for 'One-Time Password'?
questions.x: One-Time Password is abbreviated as OTP.

questions.q: Ctrl + Z is used to:
questions.x: Correct answer: Undo the last action. Ctrl + Y redoes.

questions.q:
Consider the following:
Assertion (A): We see lightning before we hear thunder.
Reason (R): Light travels much faster than sound.
Select the correct answer:
o: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
questions.x: Correct answer: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A. A is true and R is true; R correctly explains A. R explains A.

questions.q: The 'Pascal' is the SI unit of:
questions.x: Pascal measures pressure.

questions.q: A number when divided by 72 leaves a remainder of 43. What will be the remainder when the same number is divided by 4?
questions.x: N = 72k + 43. Since 4 divides 72, the remainder is simply 43 mod 4 = 3.

questions.q: A rectangular plot measures 49 m by 36 m. What is the cost of fencing it at ₹25 per metre?
In what ratio must pulses costing ₹90 per kg be mixed with pulses costing ₹120 per kg so that the mixture is worth ₹114 per kg?
questions.x:
Alligation: (dearer − mean) : (mean − cheaper) = (120 − 114) : (114 − 90) = 6 : 24 = 1 : 4.
This is cheaper : dearer.

questions.q: Find the odd one out among 189, 99, 98 and 224.
questions.x: 98, 189, 224 are all multiples of 7; 99 is not. Hence 99 is the odd one out.

questions.q: An inspector drives from town P to town Q at 90 km/h and returns along the same road at 110 km/h. The average speed for the whole journey is:
questions.x:
For equal distances, average speed = 2uv/(u + v) (harmonic mean), not (u + v)/2.
= 2 × 90 × 110 / (90 + 110) = 19800/200 = 99 km/h.

questions.q:
Production of a fertiliser unit (thousand tonnes) over five years — 2021: 190  |  2022: 240  |  2023: 260  |  2024: 290  |  2025: 260.
What is the average per year over the five years?
A train 240 m long passes a signal post in 8 seconds. Its speed in km/h is:
questions.x:
Speed = length / time = 240/8 = 30 m/s.
In km/h: 30 × 18/5 = 108 km/h.

questions.q: If 13 March of a certain year falls on a Sunday, on which day of the week will 24 August of the same year fall?
questions.x:
Days from 13 March to 24 August = 164 = 23 weeks + 3 odd days.
Sunday + 3 = Wednesday. (February is not involved, so leap years do not matter.)

questions.q: a clerk can audit a ledger in 8 days and an assistant can do it in 56 days. Working together, they will finish it in:
questions.x:
One day's work: 1/8 + 1/56 = 64/448 = 1/7.
Together they need 7 days. (Product/Sum: 8×56/(8+56) = 7.)

questions.q: A and B start a business investing ₹40,000 and ₹55,000 for a year. Out of a profit of ₹9,500, B gets:
questions.x:
Profit is shared in the ratio of capital × time.
A: 40,000×12, B: 55,000×12 → 8 : 11.
B's share = 11/19 × 9,500 = ₹5,500.

questions.q: Two inlet pipes can fill a cistern in 15 hours and 35 hours respectively, while an outlet pipe can empty the full tank in 21 hours. If all three are opened together on an empty tank, it will be full in:
questions.x:
Take tank capacity = LCM(15, 35, 21) = 105 units.
Rates: +7, +3, −5 units/hour → net 5 units/hour.
Time = 105 / 5 = 21 hours.

questions.q: In a certain code language, COURT is written as GSYVX. How is SALARY written in that code?
questions.x:
Compare COURT → GSYVX: C→G, O→S, U→Y…
Rule: each letter is moved 4 places forward in the alphabet.
Applying it to SALARY gives WEPEVC.

questions.q: Three traffic lights change at intervals of 25, 12, 36 seconds respectively. If they start together, after how long will they next coincide?
questions.x:
They coincide after LCM(25, 12, 36) seconds.
LCM = 900 s = 15 min.

questions.q: A trader buys a bicycle for ₹2,950 and sells it for ₹3,245. His profit per cent is:
questions.x:
Profit = SP − CP = ₹3,245 − ₹2,950 = ₹295.
Profit % = (Profit / CP) × 100 = (295 / 2,950) × 100 = 10%.
(Profit % is always on cost price, not on selling price.)
